en.text:
Holding down the trigger for 16 rounds (is supposed to) make the 16th round <void/>Weaken for 6 Seconds. 

Due to an unresolved bug, this gun actually only <void/>Weakens after 32 uninterrupted rounds.

Releasing the trigger after firing a Vexadecemial round (16 shots) <title refills [G_refill] /> 12 ammo from reserves on trigger release, as long as the current magazine isn't empty.
